qualitative.gate_2_reason: Speculative gold commodity price-taker with producing mines concentrated in West Africa (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso), exposed to acute geopolitical instability, coups, and Sahel resource nationalism.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Need). Speculative gold commodity price-taker whose operating mines and asset base are located in West Africa (Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal), presenting severe non-Western jurisdictional, coup, and resource nationalism risks.
qualitative.evidence: Endeavour is an unhedged gold miner whose revenue is 100% determined by spot gold prices. Producing assets (Houndé, Ity, Sabodala-Massawa, Mana) are situated entirely in West Africa, where regional instability, military juntas (Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger), and changing mining codes pose constant sovereign risk.
